_note: Review thresholds. These are house defaults chosen to start a conversation, not measured benchmarks for these channels — every one carries source:null until someone replaces it with a figure read off YouTube Studio. The analyzer prints the source beside every verdict so a house default is never mistaken for evidence.

avd_ratio._note: average view duration divided by runtime

pacing._note: Seconds per scene, parsed from each channel canon's verified-episode table. The analyzer re-derives these at run time and warns if this file has drifted from the canon.

feedback._note: A term must recur before it is reported. One comment is an anecdote.
